title: NIH Reporter Active Research Grants
description: Snapshots active NIH-funded research projects from the NIH Reporter v2 API. Fetches recently-started projects ranked by award amount. Each row identifies a project with project_num, title, organization name + state, agency IC code (NCI, NIAID, NHLBI, etc.), award_amount + total_cost, fiscal_year, project_start_date + project_end_date, principal investigator name, and a science-area tag derived from spending category. Powers the Science & Forecasting Community Brief: NIH grant awards lead biotech equity activity by 6-24 months - a sudden funding cluster around a specific therapeutic area or technology platform precedes IPO / partnership / clinical-trial activity. Free NIH Reporter API, no auth.
